title: World map overlay: in-the-Wheel poll, open/close, frees on close
oneLine: One open flag driven by a 300 ms Wheel poll, minimap tap, Town Hall row and the M key.
topConcern: openWorldMap() sets open without the inWheel test the M-key toggler makes; harmless because the render is gated and the poll resets it.

title: World map view: first view, late town-view takeover, player's own view
oneLine: waitTown/touched flags choose between the town view, you up close, and the player's own pan or zoom.

title: World map gestures: tap vs drag vs pinch
oneLine: Pointer map, pinch and press holders recognise a tap (drops a pin), a drag (pans) and a pinch (zooms).

title: Map pins: two slots, drop/replace/lift, and the reached-it card
oneLine: Per-slot row/place/armed/asked on S._mapPins, a module ask bus, a 250 ms card clock and a replace ghost.
topConcern: Module-level _ask outlives its card: an unanswered 'remove' card left in the Wheel comes back on return, as its clock only checks the pin exists.

title: Map watch heartbeat for far players (presence v2)
oneLine: Open map sends map_watch on, renewed every 4 s, off on close; the worker holds an 8 s lease.

title: World map detail tiles: fetched, held (cap 16), freed on close
oneLine: Per-tile absent/loading/held/failed lifecycle with retry, LRU trim and a generation guard across closes.
topConcern: A fetch that never settles keeps its loading slot; four such stall all later tiles for the session.

title: Harvest gesture: press, adoption, resumable meter, success
oneLine: Which finger owns the harvest gesture, the stroke tracker and the 1.5 s meter, riding on S._extraction status.
topConcern: Eight holders across five files with a history of finger-ownership fixes; the client grades 'perfect', bounded server-side; the header's 'window closes' note is stale.

title: Hold E to harvest (desktop keyboard work)
oneLine: kb holder {down, until, raf} works the gesture at a quick pace through wind-up and window, sharing settle/finish.

title: HUD popup queue: +XP and +G flights to the card or top bar
oneLine: S._hudPopups entries lift, fall or float, land (releasing holds) and are pruned at 1.6 s.
topConcern: rAF requested every frame for the whole session (only re-render skipped); the retired v2.3.1638 bar code still computes state.

title: Skill card's held XP number: frozen in flight, then counts up
oneLine: Per skill: tracking, holding (count, 2.1 s failsafe) and counting (420 ms ease) of the displayed XP.
topConcern: A popup pruned before mounting never calls landXp; a steady gain stream refreshes heldAt, freezing a card until 2.1 s after the last.

title: Kill XP inbound tokens and the top bar's landing pulse
oneLine: One idempotent token per kill flight holds the bar's +N; landing pulses via attributes on html.

title: Level-up bursts: two-slot bus and the levelUpMsg funnel
oneLine: Two fixed column slots, retire-by-seq, bounded dedup; fed by BroTown's levelUpMsg from many setters.
topConcern: Loading gate only on window._setLevelUpMsg; prog3_level, combat_credit and character levels use the raw setter, so bursts and their sting play under a veil.

title: One level-up burst's life: clock, measure-once, bubbles, sting
oneLine: Self-driven rAF clock from msg.ts, measure-once layout, one-shot points bubbles, 450 ms sting debounce.
topConcern: Hidden tab holds the slot until return; a replaced combat burst flies its bubbles from the unmount fallback (deliberate).

title: Zone-entry and land banners: one element, a timer timeline, dwell watch
oneLine: Single body element, timers guarded by _playing, 45 s repeat; Wheel lands after a 600 ms dwell.
topConcern: _wl.shown latched before playZoneBanner can refuse (no dock rect), losing that crossing's banner; the land watch asks no loading gate.

title: Guide arrow: four once-a-character lessons
oneLine: A 250 ms ticker shows weapon, swap, points and Mayor lessons by priority; done marks are stored per device.
topConcern: 'Once a character' is per device: on any new browser a veteran gets the swap lesson again for 10 s; seen-time resets on reload.

title: Intro loading screen: four gates, then the fade
oneLine: Minimum time, assets (20 s cap), server (no cap) and world gates feed one maybeFinish latch.
topConcern: The fade's setTimeout(finish) is not cancelled on unmount, so onComplete can run after the overlay was taken away.

title: Login Key form: idle, checking, confirm, switching
oneLine: Declared phase string for key entry: check via POST /api/account/login, confirm in-game, switch reloads.
topConcern: An in-flight check outlives its closed modal: on the login door, backing out mid-check still switches character when the answer lands.

title: Login Key card: the Copied! flash
oneLine: Two-state copy feedback with a 1.6 s timer and a select-and-copy fallback.

title: Mystery reveal ceremony: queue, staged spin, hold, next
oneLine: Module queue feeds an overlay: spinning stages, landed, held 1.7 s, then onDone and the next one.
topConcern: Pump takes from the queue inside a setItem updater (impure); a double-invoked updater would drop a reveal, bounded by revealBag's time limit.

title: World is full: waiting screen, endless retry, Try now
oneLine: Room-full refusal phase of wsClient's connection: fixed-cadence retries behind an updating screen.
topConcern: Try now calls connect() during an in-flight handshake: sockets overlap, onclose never checks this===ws, and orphans can veil or supersede the live session.

title: Your bro is still in that fight: linger wait and timed reconnect
oneLine: linger_wait/4010 phase: countdown screen and one reconnect timer until the body is gone.
topConcern: Socket-effect teardown hides the room-full screen but not this one, leaving a countdown over a cleared timer until the next answer.

title: Final refusal screens: not the official site; another device / key
oneLine: Terminal origin/device/key phases from join_rejected closes 4015/4016/4017; exits are reload, door or real site.

title: Star cue: big star shrinks onto the minimap's new quest star
oneLine: lastKey dedupe of the quest target and one live animated element, held while a loading screen is up.
topConcern: lastKey is latched before the box check, so a new target on a frame with no box rect never plays.

title: TimedBanner: a banner that drives its own clock
oneLine: rAF loop keyed on msg.ts re-renders the warning banner until it is ms old, then nothing.

title: Swallow the click of a tap that closed its window
oneLine: One armed {x, y, at} eats that tap's mousedown/mouseup/click; ends on click, 700 ms or a new press.

title: Tap-to-dismiss and the UI sound delegate: tap-vs-drag recognisers
oneLine: Per-surface moved flag and a page-wide last-press record decide tap or drag by slop.
topConcern: The sound delegate tracks one pointer; a second finger's press silences the first finger's button tap.

title: Player portraits in lists: bounded cache with in-flight dedupe
oneLine: Per look: absent, compositing, cached URL or null; 48 entries, oldest evicted.
topConcern: A transient composite failure is cached as null, so that look shows the letter disc for the session; the mounted guard is a stale closure.

title: Pet sheet for portraits: loaded once, retried, then held
oneLine: Promise-dedupe Image loader with retry on error; each portrait redraws on its look signature.
topConcern: After the first portrait the 768x448 pet sheet stays referenced for the session, beside the world's copy.

title: Elemental status chips and the wore-off sound
oneLine: 150 ms poll renders time-gated S._*Until statuses from the ROWS table; a since-map cues their end.
topConcern: clearElemStatuses on a zone change plays the 'wore off' cue walking through a door (only death is excluded).

title: Mayor Bro welcome video (dormant)
oneLine: Playing/closed greeting with a once-per-browser flag; nothing sets showMayorGreeting.

title: Sprite HP bar damage ghost and flash (no callers)
oneLine: Ghost hold/drain and flash on a rAF loop for a DOM HP bar that nothing renders.

title: Layout mode: upright column, computer wide, or one band
oneLine: Boot-time layout choice (address, tab, device) plus a live media query, read by deskWideActive and oneBandActive.
